items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stix Hooper called me... I knew Stix very well... Stix came over and played with my band... Stix called me and he said... I want to record you... we got a nomination for the record

ctx.x: Um, that’s why I wanted to bring my computer because I had…

That’s alright, well what’s happened – what I’m asking you is this. Because um, I was getting ready to retire, you understand? I had. I don’t realize how old I was at that time – if I knew the year we did that. But Sticks Cooper called me. Stix Hooper called. I knew Stix very well. He had – in fact I had met them the day they got to Los Angeles from Texas.
